nameEn: Real estate activities with own or leased property
description: This class includes buying, selling and renting of own or leased real estate.
includes: buying and selling of own real estate
renting and operating own or leased real estate (apartments, residential buildings, commercial buildings)
development of building projects for own operation
operation of commercial and industrial facilities for own account
excludes: development of building projects for sale, see 4100
real estate activities on a fee or contract basis, see 6820
